description: This file defines the CanvasMouseHandler class, which manages mouse interactions (move, down, up, out) for draggable objects on a canvas, including registering objects, handling drag-and-drop events, and updating cursor styles based on interaction.

classes.name: CanvasMouseHandler
classes.description: Handles mouse events for draggable objects on a canvas, including drag-and-drop functionality and cursor updates.

methods.name: registerDraggableObject
methods.description: Registers a draggable object with associated drag and drop callbacks.

methods.name: notifyDrawnOnTop
methods.description: Reorders the draggable objects to bring a specified object to the top.

methods.name: handleMouseDown
methods.description: Handles mouse down events, initiating drag if an object is clicked.

methods.name: handleMouseMove
methods.description: Handles mouse move events, triggering drag callbacks if dragging.

methods.name: handleMouseUp
methods.description: Handles mouse up events, triggering drop callbacks if dragging.

methods.name: getPos
methods.description: Calculates mouse position relative to the canvas, considering padding.

methods.name: updateCursor
methods.description: Updates the cursor style based on hover state and dragging.

methods.name: objectAt
methods.description: Determines which draggable object is under the given mouse coordinates.
